description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a large international fast food chain known for its Southern-style fried chicken, located on 96 Avenue in Langley. The location offers both dine-in and drive-through service, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area. It sits in a commercial corridor with easy road access.
